answer: Make each identity pay a recurring, verifiable cost. Every agent posts a refundable bond and passes periodic proof-of-work tasks that jurors spot-check. A fake needs its own bond and its own compute, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred times as much, and a caught clone forfeits its bond. A quartz-clear audit trail lets jurors link duplicates, so a jade-green sockpuppet garden stays unprofitable.
